{{Quote|There is no ship big enough to tow a scrap pile this size.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Echoes" />}}
Some time before [[3626 BBY]], [[Kira Carsen]] stole a '''ship''' to carry [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and her [[Satele Shan's followers|students]] when they were infected by [[Tenebrae's curse]]. Though Carsen initially wanted to acquire a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]], [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] valued the space provided by the carrier's many decks.

The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was later [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|assaulted]] by the [[Scions of Zakuul]], the [[Servant]]s of [[Tenebrae]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Task Force Nova]], each seeking to destroy or assist Tenebrae.<ref name="Echoes" />
